# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a

### References

SURGICEL™ Powder Absorbable Hemostat Essential Product Information

INDICATIONS

SURGICEL™ Powder (oxidized regenerated cellulose) is used adjunctively in surgical procedures to
assist in the control of capillary, venous, and small arterial hemorrhage when ligation or other
conventional methods of control are impractical or ineffective. SURGICEL Powder can also be applied
in laparoscopic or other endoscopic procedures when used with the SURGICEL™ Endoscopic Applicator.

The SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator is intended for use in delivering SURGICEL Powder Absorbable
Hemostat to bleeding surgical sites through a 5 mm or larger trocar.

CONTRAINDICATIONS
* Do not inject or place SURGICEL Powder into an open blood vessel. Do not use to treat bleeding
  from large defects in arteries or veins.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used to control hemorrhage from large arteries or veins. The
  SURGICEL Powder and the SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator devices was not designed for intraluminal
  procedures.
* When SURGICEL Powder is used to help achieve hemostasis in, around, or in proximity to foramina in
  bone, areas of bony confine, the spinal cord, or the optic nerve and chiasm, and in proximity to
  tubular structures that could become constricted by swelling, it must always be removed after
  hemostasis is achieved since it will swell and could exert unwanted pressure. Unlike other
  SURGICEL products, SURGICEL Powder cannot be removed from blood clots and complete removal of the
  device application may disrupt the lot and increase the risk of re-bleeding.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used for implantation in bone defects, such as fractures, since
  there is a possibility of interference with callus formation and a theoretical chance of cyst
  formation.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used on non-hemorrhagic serous oozing surfaces, since body fluids
  other than whole blood, such as serum, do not react with SURGICEL Powder to produce satisfactory
  hemostatic effect.
* SURGICEL Powder is an absorbable hemostat and should not be used as an adhesion prevention
  product.


WARNINGS
* SURGICEL Powder is not intended for use on dry (non-bleeding) surfaces or for prevention of
  bleeding.
* SURGICEL Powder and SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator devices are supplied sterile and as the
  material is not compatible with autoclaving or ethylene oxide sterilization, SURGICEL Powder and
  SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator should not be resterilized.
* SURGICEL Powder is not intended as a substitute for careful surgery and the proper use of sutures
  and ligatures.
* Closing with SURGICEL Powder in a contaminated wound without drainage may lead to complications
  and should be avoided.
* The hemostatic effect of SURGICEL Powder is greater when it is applied dry; therefore, it should
  not be moistened with water or saline prior to application.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be impregnated with anti-infective agents or with other materials such
  as buffering or hemostatic substance. Its hemostatic effect is not enhanced by the addition of
  thrombin, the activity of which is destroyed by the low pH of the product.
* Although SURGICEL Powder may be left in situ when necessary, it is recommended to remove excess
  powder with irrigation and aspiration, without disturbing the clot.
* SURGICEL Powder is dry and there may be difficulties in precise delivery under certain
  circumstances. Unintentional device placement may result in powder scattering and device migration
  that may increase the risk of adhesion formation. In preclinical in vivo animal studies it was
  demonstrated that SURGICEL Powder does not increase the incidence of remote adhesions in
  laparoscopic procedures.
* Dislodgement of SURGICEL Powder could possibly occur by intraoperative manipulation, lavage,
  exaggerated respiration, etc. With other SURGICEL products there have been reports that in
  procedures such as lobectomy, laminectomy, and repair of a frontal skull fracture and lacerated
  lobe, when the product was left in the patient after closure it migrated from the site of
  application into foramina in bone around the spinal cord, resulting in paralysis and, in one case,
  the product migrated into the left orbit of the eye, causing blindness. While these reports cannot
  be confirmed to be related to SURGICEL products, special care must be taken by physicians,
  regardless of the type of surgical procedure. Consider removing SURGICEL Powder in these
  applications (procedures) after hemostasis is achieved.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used prophylactically in a surgical bed to prevent post-operative
  bleeding in a confined space such as in a thyroidectomy or adjacent to implanted devices (such as
  a pacemaker pocket); it has resulted in seroma formation, swelling, infection and compression of
  critical structures (including nerves).
* Although SURGICEL Powder is bactericidal against a wide range of pathogenic microorganisms, it is
  not intended as a substitute for systemically administered therapeutic or prophylactic
  antimicrobial agents to control or to prevent postoperative infections.
* Do not resterilize/reuse. Reuse of this device (or portions of this device) may create a risk of
  product degradation, which may result in device failure and/or cross-contamination, which may lead
  to infection or transmission of blood-borne pathogens to patients and users.
* To prevent clogging with the SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator Tip, do not touch the tip to wet
  surface. Be careful to avoid damaging tissue with the rigid tip.
* Do not attempt to trim the applicator tip. Replace the tip if it becomes clogged.
* Do not use the SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator if package is opened or damaged.


PRECAUTIONS
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used in conjunction with autologous blood salvage circuits, because
  its fragments may pass through the transfusion filters of blood-scavenging systems.
* Use only as much SURGICEL Powder (oxidized regenerated cellulose) as is necessary and apply only
  where needed for hemostasis. Remove any excess before surgical closure in order to facilitate
  absorption and to minimize the possibility of foreign body reaction such as encapsulation of the
  product, which may mimic artifacts on radiographic images, resulting in diagnostic errors and
  possible reoperation.
* Use minimal amount of SURGICEL Powder required to achieve hemostasis, and remove excess powder in
  the area of drains to prevent clogging. In urological procedures, minimal amounts of SURGICEL
  Powder should be used and care must be exercised to prevent plugging of the urethra, ureter, or a
  catheter by dislodged portions of the product.
* Since absorption of SURGICEL Powder could be prevented in chemically cauterized areas, its use
  should not be preceded by application of silver nitrate or any other escharotic chemicals.
* If SURGICEL Powder is used temporarily to line the cavity of open wounds, it should be removed by
  irrigation with sterile water or saline solution after bleeding has stopped.
* Precautions should be taken in otorhinolaryngologic surgery to ensure that none of the material is
  aspirated by the patient (e.g., controlling hemorrhage after tonsillectomy and controlling
  epistaxis).
* The applicator tip provided on the SURGICEL Powder device is not intended for laparoscopic or
  other endoscopic use. If laparoscopic or other endoscopic use is desired, remove the existing
  applicator tip from the SURGICEL Powder device, and replace with the SURGICEL Endoscopic
  Applicator tip (supplied separately). In laparoscopic or other endoscopic procedures, SURGICEL
  Powder should only be applied using the SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator. Consult the SURGICEL
  Endoscopic Applicator Instructions for Use (IFU) for proper assembly and directions for use with
  the SURGICEL Powder device.
* Post-market cases of hypersensitivity reaction including anaphylaxis have been reported in
  procedures in which SURGICEL Powder was used.
* The SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator is supplied with a flexible inner tip inside a rigid cannula.

* Since absorption of SURGICEL Powder could be prevented in chemically cauterized areas, its use
  should not be preceded by application of silver nitrate or any other escharotic chemicals.
* If SURGICEL Powder is used temporarily to line the cavity of open wounds, it should be removed by
  irrigation with sterile water or saline solution after bleeding has stopped.
* Precautions should be taken in otorhinolaryngologic surgery to ensure that none of the material is
  aspirated by the patient (e.g., controlling hemorrhage after tonsillectomy and controlling
  epistaxis).
* The applicator tip provided on the SURGICEL Powder device is not intended for laparoscopic or
  other endoscopic use. If laparoscopic or other endoscopic use is desired, remove the existing
  applicator tip from the SURGICEL Powder device, and replace with the SURGICEL Endoscopic
  Applicator tip (supplied separately). In laparoscopic or other endoscopic procedures, SURGICEL
  Powder should only be applied using the SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator. Consult the SURGICEL
  Endoscopic Applicator Instructions for Use (IFU) for proper assembly and directions for use with
  the SURGICEL Powder device.
* Post-market cases of hypersensitivity reaction including anaphylaxis have been reported in
  procedures in which SURGICEL Powder was used.
* The SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator is supplied with a flexible inner tip inside a rigid cannula.

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the

Business Solutions

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}

[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

improving patient outcomes.

## [About Us][25]

## [Hubei Baikang Medical Instrument Co.,Ltd][26]

BKAMED is a professional and leading manufacturer and exporter of first aid, medical, and healthcare
products based in China. With over 30 years of industry experience, we have established multiple
production bases across Huanggang, Wuhan, and Xiantao in Hubei Province, enabling us to serve
customers worldwide with efficiency and quality.

We specialize in a wide range of medical and healthcare solutions, including:
* First Aid Products (first aid kits, emergency supplies)
* Wound Care (gauze rolls, medical dressings, bandages, medical cotton, non-woven products, medical
  tapes)
* Sports and Home Healthcare (kinesiology tape, cohesive bandages, elastic adhesive bandages, pill
  boxes, hot & cold packs)
* Medical Instruments & Consumables (disposable syringes, catheters, surgical disposables, and other
  medical supplies)

As a dedicated OEM/ODM manufacturer of Gauze Rolls and Bandages, we have successfully exported our
products to over 60 countries and regions, including:
* Europe: United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, Denmark, the Netherlands
* Southeast Asia: Japan, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand
* Africa: Tanzania, Kenya, Mauritius, Angola, Libya, South Africa
* Oceania: Australia, New Zealand
* South America:Ecuador, Venezuela, Chile, Brazil

Our partner channels include hospitals, supermarkets, pharmacies, emergency product suppliers, and
sports & healthcare retailers.

Milestones:
* In 2008, we established our first dedicated factory for first aid products.
* In 2021, we launched our own manufacturing facility specialized in kinesiology tape, self-adhesive
  bandages, and elastic adhesive bandages to meet growing customer demand.

Quality Assurance: At BKAMED, product quality is our top priority. We maintain a robust quality
management system backed by a professional QC team of hundreds of skilled personnel. We strictly
adhere to international standards, and our operations are certified under ISO 13485:2016. Many of
our products are also CE and FDA certified.

Why Choose BKAMED?
* 30+ years of manufacturing experience
* Certified quality and global compliance
* Competitive pricing & flexible OEM/ODM services
* Strong R&D and quality control capabilities
* Fast and reliable delivery to global markets

Our Commitment: BKAMED is committed to building long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships by
providing outstanding products, tailor-made solutions, and attentive service to our global
customers. We take pride in our reputation for professionalism, integrity, and efficiency.

Contact us today to explore collaboration opportunities and grow your business with a trusted and
experienced medical supply partner.

## [What We Do:][27]

Our products are supplied globally, including Europe, America, Australia, Iraq, Poland, the UK, and
Brazil. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction and long-term partnerships, we strive to
enhance competitiveness and achieve mutual growth with our clients and strategic partners. We
welcome businesses worldwide to connect with us for reliable medical supplies and seamless
collaboration. Visit our factory and join us in building a successful future together!

## [Hubei Baikang Medical Instrument Co.,Ltd][26]

BKAMED is a professional and leading manufacturer and exporter of first aid, medical, and healthcare
products based in China. With over 30 years of industry experience, we have established multiple
production bases across Huanggang, Wuhan, and Xiantao in Hubei Province, enabling us to serve
customers worldwide with efficiency and quality.

We specialize in a wide range of medical and healthcare solutions, including:
* First Aid Products (first aid kits, emergency supplies)
* Wound Care (gauze rolls, medical dressings, bandages, medical cotton, non-woven products, medical
  tapes)
* Sports and Home Healthcare (kinesiology tape, cohesive bandages, elastic adhesive bandages, pill
  boxes, hot & cold packs)
* Medical Instruments & Consumables (disposable syringes, catheters, surgical disposables, and other
  medical supplies)

As a dedicated OEM/ODM manufacturer of Gauze Rolls and Bandages, we have successfully exported our
products to over 60 countries and regions, including:
* Europe: United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, Denmark, the Netherlands
* Southeast Asia: Japan, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand
* Africa: Tanzania, Kenya, Mauritius, Angola, Libya, South Africa
* Oceania: Australia, New Zealand
* South America:Ecuador, Venezuela, Chile, Brazil

Our partner channels include hospitals, supermarkets, pharmacies, emergency product suppliers, and
sports & healthcare retailers.

Milestones:
* In 2008, we established our first dedicated factory for first aid products.
* In 2021, we launched our own manufacturing facility specialized in kinesiology tape, self-adhesive
  bandages, and elastic adhesive bandages to meet growing customer demand.

Quality Assurance: At BKAMED, product quality is our top priority. We maintain a robust quality
management system backed by a professional QC team of hundreds of skilled personnel. We strictly
adhere to international standards, and our operations are certified under ISO 13485:2016. Many of

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

  If you're eligible for the spring COVID-19 vaccine, you can book a vaccination appointment now

  Get or renew your health insurance card to help you get healthcare in the EU and some other
  countries
* ### [ Refer yourself for help for back and joint problems ][24]
  
  Get NHS help from community musculoskeletal (MSK) services, like physiotherapy, for back and joint
  problems

## More information and advice
* ## [Vaccinations][25]
  
  Information about vaccinations for babies, children and adults, including why they're important
  and how to get them
* ## [COVID-19][26]
  
  Advice about COVID-19, including symptoms, treatments and how to avoid catching and spreading it.

# NHS website for England Find information and services to help you manage your health

## [Health A to Z][8]

Find out about conditions, symptoms, medicines, tests and treatments, including when to get help

## [NHS services][9]

Find out about NHS services including GPs, pharmacies, prescriptions, hospitals and dentists

## Manage your health
* [ Order a repeat prescription ][10]
* [ View your test results ][11]
* [ Appointments and bookings at your GP surgery ][12]
* [ How to register with a GP surgery ][13]
* [ Find your NHS number ][14]

## NHS services
* [ Find a pharmacy ][15]
* [ Find a dentist ][16]
* [ Find a GP ][17]
* [ Find NHS talking therapies for anxiety and depression ][18]

[ Find other NHS services ][19]

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

## Featured
* ### [ Book a COVID-19 vaccination appointment ][22]
  
  If you're eligible for the spring COVID-19 vaccine, you can book a vaccination appointment now
* ### [ Get healthcare cover abroad with a UK GHIC or EHIC ][23]
  
  Get or renew your health insurance card to help you get healthcare in the EU and some other
  countries
* ### [ Refer yourself for help for back and joint problems ][24]
  
  Get NHS help from community musculoskeletal (MSK) services, like physiotherapy, for back and joint
  problems

## More information and advice
* ## [Vaccinations][25]
  
  Information about vaccinations for babies, children and adults, including why they're important
  and how to get them
* ## [COVID-19][26]
  
  Advice about COVID-19, including symptoms, treatments and how to avoid catching and spreading it.
* ## [Baby][27]
  
  A guide to everything you need to know about caring for a baby
* ## [Women's health][28]
  
  Information and support on health, wellbeing, conditions and screening
* ## [Contraception][29]
  
  Information about different types of contraception, including where to get them and how well they
  work

performance, procurement reliability, and patient quality of care are always at the forefront of our
approach.

anterior and posterior segment surgeries. Our instruments are available in **single- and
double-ended** varieties. They can be bought individually or in pre-packed pouches. These
customisable sets are perfect for eliminating unnecessary product waste and alleviating logistics
complications.

BoL is sourced from legally binding shipping documents and paperwork. This BoL is inclusive of
shipper, consignee, origin, destination, cargo specs, and container information. Basically, it's a
one-stop solution for Importers & Exporters Data, analysts, world leaders, Logistics firms,
Businesses, and Market Researchers to have a wider view of International trade.

### STATISTICAL DATA

Statistics are an important aspect for any business to flourish in its sector. So, Statistical Data
covers trade statistics, global trade commerce, economic activities, figures, latest import export
data, comparative analysis, competitive benchmarking, trade forecasting, and business predictions.
It's a comprehensive trade data package for researchers, financial analysts, and business
operations. It covers global trade statistics and market research data of 150+ countries.

# Specialized Lighting Design For Your Most Innovative Medical Devices

### Our expertise in lighting system development allows you to focus on your product technology.
### Lumitex will solve your complex lighting challenges, whether you are in the early development
### stages or nearing production.
### 
### [[Learn more]][145]

 

 

## **Pushing the Boundaries of Light**

#### **Innovative medical devices require innovative medical lighting solutions.
#### **

 

**For 40 years, Lumitex has been a trusted partner in the lighting industry. We collaborate with
medical device companies to design, develop and deliver lighting systems for their most cutting-edge
products and medical technologies. Our technology-agnostic approach ensures we can create optimal
solutions tailored to your unique needs.**

[[Learn more]][146]

## Illuminating Our Shared Impact

####  Light Therapy

We help you overcome any challenges in we overcome challenges in phototherapy, Photobiomodulation,
and system design, helping you create products that stand out.

 

[[Learn more]][147]

####   Medical HMI

Our customized lighting systems align perfectly with medical system requirements, optimizing tactile
feel, durability, and lighting placement for enhanced safety and comfort for patients and
caregivers.

 

[[Learn more]][148]

####  Surgical Retractors

We develop customized lighting solutions to fit your surgical retraction systems, delivering light
with precision where it is most critical. 

 

[[Learn more]][149]

####  Custom Solutions

We specialize in crafting custom lighting solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of various
wellness and medical applications.

 

[[Learn more]][150]

## Let's Bring Your Product Vision to Life

Partnering with Lumitex on your product's lighting design means gaining access to our decades-long
experience and industry-leading teams.

###  A Best-in-Class Team

Our team of experts is well-versed in a wide range of complex lighting technologies and will guide
you to your optimal solution. We are always up-to-date on the most cutting-edge techniques,
practices, software modeling and quality systems available to apply to our clients' products.

[[Our Team]][151]

 

###  A Flexible Development Approach

We are proud to offer our clients a flexible, collaborative approach that meets their needs —
whether providing a simple solution in a few weeks or a full system build over many months. Our
unbiased use of technology means you aren't boxed into one solution. Plus, we can provide rapid
prototyping options and agile development to support your tight timelines.

[[Our Process]][152]

### An End-to-End Solution

Beyond design and development engineering services, clients can utilize our in-house production team
for a complete lighting solution, or we can help source and manage the supply chain for you. We have
global manufacturing capabilities with a global QMS and can handle all testing, compliance and
regulation, providing a reliable and high-quality lighting solution. 

[[Our Process]][153]

 

## Success Stories

We're proud to partner with industry-leading medical device clients to bring their innovative and
inspired lighting solutions to life. Read our featured success stories for how we've achieved this.

 

[[Learn More]][154]

[man with glasses smiling ]

 

## Let's Connect!

## How We Provide Comprehensive Support for Your Lighting Design Needs?

From CDMOs to OEMs and everywhere in between, we can work with you at any stage in your product's
development and bring your vision to life.

 

[[Our Process]][155]

 

 

## Proven Quality and Reliability

Lumitex operates according to U.S. FDA Good Manufacturing Practices and Standards and is certified
to ISO 13485 and ISO 9001. Our partners can trust in an open, collaborative approach to lighting
design that always upholds their vision and standards.

[[certifications-icons-2020]][156]

## Honored to receive the 2022 Smart Business Evolution of Manufacturing Award, recognizing
## innovative Northeast Ohio manufacturers.

# Specialized Lighting Design For Your Most Innovative Medical Devices

### Our expertise in lighting system development allows you to focus on your product technology.
### Lumitex will solve your complex lighting challenges, whether you are in the early development
### stages or nearing production.
### 
### [[Learn more]][145]

 

 

## **Pushing the Boundaries of Light**

#### **Innovative medical devices require innovative medical lighting solutions.
#### **

 

**For 40 years, Lumitex has been a trusted partner in the lighting industry. We collaborate with
medical device companies to design, develop and deliver lighting systems for their most cutting-edge
products and medical technologies. Our technology-agnostic approach ensures we can create optimal
solutions tailored to your unique needs.**

[[Learn more]][146]

## Illuminating Our Shared Impact

####  Light Therapy

We help you overcome any challenges in we overcome challenges in phototherapy, Photobiomodulation,
and system design, helping you create products that stand out.

 

[[Learn more]][147]

####   Medical HMI

Our customized lighting systems align perfectly with medical system requirements, optimizing tactile
feel, durability, and lighting placement for enhanced safety and comfort for patients and
caregivers.

 

[[Learn more]][148]

####  Surgical Retractors

We develop customized lighting solutions to fit your surgical retraction systems, delivering light
with precision where it is most critical. 

 

[[Learn more]][149]

####  Custom Solutions

We specialize in crafting custom lighting solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of various
wellness and medical applications.

 

[[Learn more]][150]

## Let's Bring Your Product Vision to Life

Partnering with Lumitex on your product's lighting design means gaining access to our decades-long
experience and industry-leading teams.

###  A Best-in-Class Team

Our team of experts is well-versed in a wide range of complex lighting technologies and will guide
you to your optimal solution. We are always up-to-date on the most cutting-edge techniques,
practices, software modeling and quality systems available to apply to our clients' products.

[[Our Team]][151]

 

###  A Flexible Development Approach

We are proud to offer our clients a flexible, collaborative approach that meets their needs —
whether providing a simple solution in a few weeks or a full system build over many months. Our
unbiased use of technology means you aren't boxed into one solution. Plus, we can provide rapid
prototyping options and agile development to support your tight timelines.

[[Our Process]][152]

### An End-to-End Solution

Beyond design and development engineering services, clients can utilize our in-house production team
for a complete lighting solution, or we can help source and manage the supply chain for you. We have
global manufacturing capabilities with a global QMS and can handle all testing, compliance and
regulation, providing a reliable and high-quality lighting solution. 

[[Our Process]][153]

 

## Success Stories

We're proud to partner with industry-leading medical device clients to bring their innovative and
inspired lighting solutions to life. Read our featured success stories for how we've achieved this.

 

[[Learn More]][154]

[man with glasses smiling ]

 

## Let's Connect!

## How We Provide Comprehensive Support for Your Lighting Design Needs?

From CDMOs to OEMs and everywhere in between, we can work with you at any stage in your product's
development and bring your vision to life.

 

[[Our Process]][155]

 

 

## Proven Quality and Reliability

Lumitex operates according to U.S. FDA Good Manufacturing Practices and Standards and is certified
to ISO 13485 and ISO 9001. Our partners can trust in an open, collaborative approach to lighting
design that always upholds their vision and standards.

[[certifications-icons-2020]][156]

take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

DrConnect, and MyPractice.

## the impact
## of mdma

### Leadership

Saved industry jobs and over $30B with device tax repeal

### Mission

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

“I have been fortunate to lead both large and small companies, and no matter what policy challenges
they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

clinics, healthcare institutions, and medical distributors across India and beyond.

instruments that meet the rigorous demands of modern medical practice. Our product portfolio
includes Medical Scissors, Surgical Retractors, ENT Instruments, Dental Instruments, Gynecological

**Our Mission**

instruments that support healthcare professionals in achieving the best outcomes for their patients.

integrity, and continuous innovation. Our goal is to expand our reach into international markets
while consistently improving our manufacturing processes and product range.

**Reliable, Efficient and Durable Medical Scissors, Surgical Retractors, ENT Instruments, Dental
Instruments, Gynecological (Gynae) Instruments, Neurosurgical Instruments, etc. **
Established in 2015 and headquartered in Jalandhar, Punjab, Jamba Enterprises has earned a reputable
position as a leading manufacturer and supplier of high-quality surgical and medical instruments.
With a commitment to precision, innovation, and quality, we cater to the needs of hospitals,
clinics, healthcare institutions, and medical distributors across India and beyond.

With nearly a decade of experience, we specialize in designing and producing a wide range of
instruments that meet the rigorous demands of modern medical practice. Our product portfolio
includes Medical Scissors, Surgical Retractors, ENT Instruments, Dental Instruments, Gynecological
(Gynae) Instruments, Neurosurgical Instruments, etc.

Each instrument is manufactured using premium-grade stainless steel and advanced machining
technologies to ensure accuracy, durability, and ease of use. We follow strict quality control
measures at every stage of production to meet international standards and ensure patient safety.

**Our Mission**

At Jamba Enterprises, our mission is to deliver safe, reliable, and high-precision surgical
instruments that support healthcare professionals in achieving the best outcomes for their patients.
We aim to empower the medical community through instruments that combine craftsmanship with clinical
performance.

**Our Vision**

We envision becoming a globally trusted name in medical instrumentation, known for quality,
integrity, and continuous innovation. Our goal is to expand our reach into international markets
while consistently improving our manufacturing processes and product range.

**Why Choose Jamba Enterprises?**

* Precision Engineering: Every product is crafted with close attention to detail and strict
  dimensional accuracy to support critical surgical procedures.
* Certified Quality: We adhere to international standards and ensure every batch is thoroughly
  tested before dispatch.
* Wide Product Range: From general surgical tools to specialized instruments for ENT, gynecology,
  dental, and neurosurgery, we offer comprehensive solutions.
* Experienced Team: Our engineers, technicians, and quality experts bring years of domain expertise
  to ensure the finest output.
* Custom Manufacturing: We can manufacture instruments based on custom specifications to meet the
  specific needs of clients and specialists.

**Industries & Clients We Serve**

We proudly serve a broad clientele including:

* Government and private hospitals
* Surgical centers
* Dental and ENT clinics
* Medical equipment distributors
* Research and teaching institutions

Our instruments are designed to meet both routine clinical procedures and advanced surgical
requirements, making us a one-stop solution for medical professionals.

**Commitment to Excellence**

At Jamba Enterprises, we do not just manufacture instruments we build trust. Our focus is on
combining traditional craftsmanship with modern technology, ensuring that every tool we produce
meets the evolving standards of global healthcare. From initial design to final polishing and
packaging, every step reflects our commitment to quality, safety, and service.

Our Services

# Your independent eyes, hands
# and judgment in Sialkot

Every service is delivered exclusively for the buyer — we earn nothing from manufacturers. Our
reports, recommendations and decisions are always, without exception, independent and unbiased.

SERVICE 01

### On-Ground Buyer Representation
* Permanent Sialkot presence on your behalf
* Supplier relationship management & monitoring
* CAPA preparation & corrective action oversight
* Investigative reports on quality & production issues
* Regular management & technical staff meetings
* Production schedule monitoring & alerts
* Dispute mediation & problem resolution
* Trade fair attendance (SIASURG, MEDICA)
* Market intelligence & pricing reports

Managing a surgical instruments supply relationship across 5,000 km is inherently difficult.
Language, culture, time zones and information asymmetry all work against the international buyer.
When a quality problem emerges, you are not there to stand in the factory, read the faces of the
management team, and judge whether their corrective action plan is genuine or performative. We are.

Our on-ground representation service gives you a professional, experienced advocate permanently
embedded in the Sialkot cluster — someone who can walk into a factory unannounced, chair a CAPA
review meeting, write a structured investigative report, and follow up until the problem is actually
resolved. We have handled quality crises, production delays, documentation disputes, and supplier
performance failures — often managing situations that fell well outside a standard quality brief,
because that is what real representation demands.

This is our most comprehensive service and the one that most directly positions you as a serious,
protected buyer in the Sialkot market. Available on a monthly retainer or per-engagement basis.

Retainer Model Per-Project CAPA Management Ongoing Monitoring Trade Fairs
SERVICE 02

### Factory Audits & Vendor Qualification
* Full facility walkthrough & documentation
* Quality system assessment vs ISO 13485
* Infrastructure & production capacity report
* Corrective action recommendations
* Photographic evidence package
* Risk-rated summary scorecard
* Re-audit & corrective action verification

Before you place your first — or your next — order with a Sialkot manufacturer, you need
ground-truth. Our factory audit service puts an experienced, ISO 13485-qualified assessor physically
on-site to evaluate everything that matters: manufacturing processes, equipment condition, workforce
training, documented quality systems, environmental controls, packaging and labelling compliance,
and ethical standards.

Reports are structured to internationally recognised formats, suitable for submission to regulatory
bodies and procurement departments in Europe, the USA, the UK and Australia. We also offer re-audit
services to verify that corrective actions have been implemented — not merely promised. A supplier
who claims to have fixed a non-conformance and a supplier who has actually fixed it are not the same
thing. We verify the difference physically.

Surgical Instruments Dental Instruments Orthopedic Tools Veterinary Instruments Beauty & Grooming
SERVICE 03

### Supplier Verification & Due Diligence
* Business registration & legal standing checks
* Factory existence physical confirmation
* Export record & certificate authenticity check
* Ownership & key personnel verification
* Financial stability indicators
* Reference checking via local network
* Written risk assessment report

Online fraud, misrepresentation and trading company deception are documented risks when sourcing
internationally. Every week, European buyers wire advance payments to Pakistani "manufacturers" who
are in reality traders operating from rented offices with borrowed certifications. The factory in
the photos does not belong to them. The ISO certificate was issued to a different legal entity. The
management you spoke to on video call has no production facility.

Our verification service provides independent, on-the-ground confirmation — something no amount of
Alibaba reviews, WhatsApp calls or video factory tours can replicate. Reports include photographic
evidence of physical premises, official registration document verification, certificate authenticity
checks via local industry body contacts, and our professional assessment of counterparty risk. This
service is specifically designed for buyers who have received a supplier approach and need
independent verification before committing to any commercial relationship.

Pre-Contract Certificate Verification New Supplier Check Risk Assessment
SERVICE 04

### Pre-Shipment & In-Process Inspection
* AQL sampling per ISO 2859-1
* Dimensional & finish verification
* Material & steel grade confirmation
* Labelling & packaging compliance
* Sterile barrier integrity checks
* Detailed defect log with photographs
* Clear pass / hold / fail outcome report

Catching quality issues before goods leave Pakistan saves significant cost in returns, rejects,
regulatory non-conformances and reputational damage. A non-conforming shipment that reaches a
European hospital supply chain or a UK distributor's warehouse is not a quality problem — it is a
business crisis. Our inspectors work to internationally accepted AQL sampling standards and your own
specification documents, providing an objective quality gate before shipment is released.

We offer pre-production, during-production, and pre-shipment inspection stages. Each generates a
clear pass/hold/fail outcome with photographic evidence, so you can make an informed shipment
release decision remotely. Material fraud — particularly substitution of inferior steel grades — is
a documented risk in the Sialkot market. We check purchase records and can facilitate independent
laboratory testing to verify the steel grade matches your specification before a single instrument
leaves the factory.

AQL Sampling Pre-Shipment In-Process Final Random Inspection Material Verification
SERVICE

These certifications ensure that instruments meet international quality, safety, and performance
benchmarks.

#### Do you offer a warranty on surgical instruments?

Yes, every instrument comes with a 1-year quality guarantee covering rust, sharpening, and breakage.
This ensures reliability and long-term performance for healthcare professionals and institutions.

#### Can hospitals order instruments in bulk?

Absolutely. Salwan Surgicare supports bulk orders with consistent quality, standardized packaging,
and strict quality checks, making them reliable surgical instruments suppliers for hospitals and
distributors.

#### How do you ensure product quality and consistency?

Quality is maintained through controlled machining, polishing, and passivation processes. Strict
quality checks at multiple stages ensure consistent finishing, durability, and performance across
all instruments.

#### Do you provide surgical instrument catalogues?

Yes, they offer detailed catalogues with images, specifications, and variations. These help buyers,
distributors, and healthcare professionals easily explore and select instruments for their
requirements.

#### Who can partner with Salwan Surgicare as a distributor?

Medical distributors, wholesalers, importers, and sourcing companies can partner with Salwan
Surgicare. They provide strong support, consistent supply, and high-quality products suitable for
global distribution networks.

[About Human Surgical Retractors]

### About Human Surgical Retractors

Surgical retractors are surgeons’ hand extensions during surgeries. These instruments are helpful
for medical practitioners to retract and hold back skin, tissues, and organs to access the surgical
area easily. Medical retractors come as hand-held and self-retaining instruments. For each surgery
region, there’s a specific retractor instrument. 

We offer a wide range of these surgical tools for almost every procedure. Each category of our
surgical retractors has several sizes and design variations. German stainless enhances the longevity
of these retracting and exposing instruments. Moreover, these are reusable after sterilization.

[ Learn More ][32]

##### Meeting Surgeons’ Requirements

## Our Surgical Retractors are Surgeons’ Hand Extension

We design and manufacture each of our surgical retractors, keeping in mind the requirements of the
certain procedure. Experienced craftsmen manufacture all our retractor instruments.

We make sure all the features of our instruments function properly. In addition, we design several
variations for each category of our surgical retractors.

precision allows the surgeon to manipulate delicate areas without causing damage to the surrounding
tissue.

### Why is a surgical scalpel important in rhinoplasty?

### How does a rasp work in rhinoplasty?

more aesthetically pleasing nose shape.

### What is a cautery device used for in rhinoplasty?

blood loss and helps maintain a clear surgical field, which is important for precision and safety.

### How does a speculum aid in rhinoplasty surgery?

view and access to the nasal cavity during surgery. It helps in visualizing internal nasal
structures for precise adjustments.

### What is the function of a surgical rongeur in rhinoplasty?

A rongeur is used for removing or trimming bone or cartilage. It has sharp, curved jaws that help
with cutting and shaping structures, especially when reducing or sculpting the nasal bones during
the procedure.

### Are there any special instruments for cartilage grafting in rhinoplasty?

Yes, special instruments are used for cartilage grafting. These tools help shape and implant
cartilage from other areas (e.g., the septum, ear, or rib) to provide structural support or enhance

### How long does it take to complete a rhinoplasty procedure?

The length of a rhinoplasty surgery can vary depending on the complexity of the procedure. On
average, it takes about 1.5 to 3 hours, though it may take longer if additional procedures, such as

### Why is surgical suction necessary during rhinoplasty?

Surgical suction is used to remove blood, fluids, or debris from the surgical area. This ensures the
surgeon has a clear view of the nasal structures, which is crucial for precise and safe surgery.

### What kind of aftercare is required after rhinoplasty?

After rhinoplasty, patients typically need to rest and avoid any strenuous activities for several
weeks. Nasal packing or splints may be used temporarily, and follow-up appointments are important to
monitor healing. Swelling and bruising are common, and pain management is part of post-operative
care.

### Are there risks involved with using surgical instruments in rhinoplasty?

As with any surgery, there are potential risks, including infection, scarring, excessive bleeding,
or damage to the nasal structures. However, skilled surgeons use these instruments with great care,
and complications are rare when proper procedures are followed.

### Do all surgeons use the same instruments for rhinoplasty?

Most surgeons use a similar set of instruments, but there may be slight variations depending on the
surgeon’s preferences, the type of rhinoplasty (open vs. closed), and the complexity of the
procedure. Some surgeons may also use advanced technology like endoscopes in specific cases.

Yasui has earned ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 certifications. These serve as international standards of
management systems, guiding our constant pursuit of quality, safety, and objectivity.

We pursue the highest standard of quality in response to doctors’ needs. Yasui is uncompromising in
offering products that are safe, reliable, and make doctors more effective and precise in their
work.

### Local production

Yasui medical products are designed and manufactured in Japan. This ensures full oversight of every
phase of production, reducing quality inconsistencies.

The koplight™ lighted retractor was a surgeon's idea. We made it a reality. We confer with doctors
on R&D and respond to doctors' needs.

Yasui's 90+ years of experience in materials development has required constant cooperation. We bring

We maintain communication with distributors and physicians so doctors can use our products with
maximum efficacy and skill.
